title: 第010章 领令独身离仙山，缓步初至落云村
content_zh:
与此同时，院中正在帮同门疗愈的蔡文姬，似有所感。

    她微微抬眸，目光淡淡扫过巷道拐角。

    精准捕捉到那一抹阴暗扭曲的嫉妒视线。

    她心底轻轻一叹。

    果然。

    人心最难渡，恶念最难平。

    她从未主动招惹过蔡文龙。

    可对方的偏见、狭隘、嫉妒，却从未停止滋生。

    既然不知悔改，那就怪不得她不留情面了。

    她不主动害人，但绝不纵容恶念缠身的小人作祟。

    一上午的疗愈结束，积累的功德让她修为稳稳踏入炼气一层巅峰。

    源源不断的功德沉淀在体内胡笳仙骨，骨体愈发凝实。

    距离突破炼气二层，只差一步之遥。

    技能范围、治愈强度、眩晕时长，全部小幅升级。

    尤其是二技能【胡笳乐】，如今可以实现二次弹射、连锁控场。

    对付多人抱团作恶，效果更强、更无解。

    午后，外门管事周管事亲自登门。

    老者手中拿着一份崭新的宗门任务卷轴，面带笑意走进小院，身后还跟着一个身形挺拔的青年修士。

    “蔡小姬。”

    “弟子在。”蔡文姬起身行礼，乖巧有礼。

    周管事看着眼前懂事温柔、天赋奇异的少女，越看越满意。

    “你虽刚入宗门，但心性端正、行善积德、整顿外门风气，有目共睹，值得嘉奖。”

    “近日青螺山外围两个村落频发邪祟扰人之事，有低阶散修暗中欺压凡人、掠夺百姓香火物资。”

    “宗门决定派你下山巡查，肃清周边邪祟、惩治恶修、安抚凡俗。”

    “此事不算强制任务，算作宗门历练，完成之后，可累积宗门功绩，优先争夺下月内门提拔名额。”

    这哪里是任务，分明是赤裸裸的重点培养、保送优待。

    寻常外门弟子，只能接取砍柴、采药、扫山的基础杂役任务。

    唯独她，直接接手惩恶扬善、积累大功德的高阶历练任务。

    话音刚落，周管事侧身指了指身后的青年，补充道：“你刚入门，修为尚浅，独自下山我终究放心不下。”

    “这是王磊，炼气四层，常年在外历练，经验丰富，为人沉稳可靠。我特意让他陪你一同下山，遇事也好有个照应。”

    王磊上前一步，对着蔡文姬拱手行礼，脸上带着真诚的笑意：“蔡师妹，之前多谢你出手治好我的旧伤。此次下山，我定护你周全。”

    正是那日半山腰被蔡文姬治愈多年顽疾的外门弟子。

    他感念蔡文姬的恩情，听闻周管事要派人陪同，主动请缨前来。

    蔡文姬眼睛微微一亮，对着王磊微微颔首：“有劳王师兄了。”

    她正愁宗门之内都是同门，不好大肆出手、积攒功德。

    下山巡查？
content_en:
At the same time, Cai Wenji, who was helping a fellow student heal in the hospital, seemed to feel something.

    She raised her eyes slightly and scanned the corner of the alley.

    Accurately capturing that dark and twisted look of jealousy.

    She sighed softly in her heart.

    really.

    The human heart is the most difficult to overcome, and evil thoughts are the most difficult to calm down.

    She has never taken the initiative to provoke Cai Wenlong.

    But the other party's prejudice, narrow-mindedness, and jealousy have never stopped growing.

    Since she is unrepentant, no wonder she is so ruthless.

    She does not take the initiative to harm others, but she will never condone villains with evil intentions.

    After a morning of healing, the accumulated merits allowed her to reach the peak of the first level of Qi refining.

    A steady stream of merit is deposited in the Hujia Immortal Bones in the body, and the bones become more solid.

    There is only one step away from breaking through the second level of Qi Refining.

    Skill range, healing intensity, and stun duration have all been slightly upgraded.

    Especially the second skill [Hu Jia Le] can now achieve secondary ejection and chain control of the field.

    When dealing with multiple people working together to commit evil, the effect is stronger and more incomprehensible.

    In the afternoon, Manager Zhou, the external manager, came to the door in person.

    The old man held a brand new sect mission scroll in his hand and walked into the small courtyard with a smile on his face, followed by a tall and tall young monk.

    "Cai Xiaoji."

    "Disciple is here." Cai Wenji stood up and saluted, obediently and politely.

    Manager Zhou looked at the sensible, gentle and gifted girl in front of him, and the more he looked at it, the more satisfied he became.

    "Although you have just joined the sect, your upright nature, good deeds, and rectification of the outer sect's atmosphere are obvious to all, and you are worthy of commendation."

    "Recently, there have been frequent incidents of evil spirits disturbing people in the two villages outside Qingluo Mountain. There are low-level casual cultivators who secretly bully mortals and plunder people's incense and supplies."

    "The sect has decided to send you down the mountain to patrol the area to eliminate evil spirits, punish evil cultivators, and appease the common people."

    "This is not a compulsory task, it is considered as sect experience. After completion, you can accumulate sect merit and give priority to competing for promotion spots in the inner sect next month."

    This is not a task, it is clearly a focus on training, recommendation and preferential treatment.

    Ordinary outer disciples can only accept basic chore tasks of chopping wood, collecting herbs, and sweeping mountains.

    She is the only one who directly takes over the high-level training tasks of punishing evil and promoting good, and accumulating great merit.

    As soon as he finished speaking, Manager Zhou pointed sideways at the young man behind him, and added: "You have just started, and your cultivation is still shallow. After all, I can't worry about going down the mountain alone."

    "This is Wang Lei, who is at the fourth level of Qi Refining. He has been practicing abroad all year round. He is rich in experience and is calm and reliable. I specially asked him to accompany you down the mountain so that you can take care of him in case of trouble."

    Wang Lei took a step forward and saluted Cai Wenji with a sincere smile on his face: "Junior Sister Cai, thank you for healing my old injury. I will protect you when you go down the mountain this time."

    It was the outer disciple who had been cured of a long-standing illness by Cai Wenji on the mountainside that day.

    He was grateful for Cai Wenji's kindness, and when he heard that Manager Zhou was going to send someone to accompany him, he took the initiative to invite Miao to come.

    Cai Wenji's eyes lit up slightly, and she nodded slightly to Wang Lei: "Thank you, Senior Brother Wang."

    She was worried that since everyone in the sect was from the same sect, it would be difficult for her to take action and accumulate merit.

    Going down the mountain for inspection?
title_en: Chapter 010 The leader left Fairy Mountain alone and slowly arrived at Luoyun Village.
